title: Telex Draft 0 Event and Profile Validation

tests.description: The implicit complete profile accepts flat objects, attributes, lists, nodes, and node content

path=$.a
kind=object
identity=root-a

path=$.a.@.source
kind=string
value=fixture

path=$.a.items
kind=list

path=$.a.items[0]
kind=node

path=$.a.items[0][0]

value=tag

path=$.a.items[0][0][0]
kind=boolean
value=true
origin=sha256:0123456789abcdef0123456789abcdef0123456789abcdef0123456789abcdef
span=8:12

path=$.a.b
